verses.text: "In those days and at that time, when I bring back the people of Judah and Jerusalem from captivity,

I will gather all the nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. There I will put them on trial for what they did to my people, my own people Israel. They scattered my people among the nations and divided up my land.
They threw dice for my people. They traded boys for prostitutes and sold girls for wine to drink.

"Now what do you have against me, Tyre and Sidon and all you regions of Philistia? Are you paying me back for something? If you are, I will very quickly turn back on your own heads whatever you have done.
You took my silver and my gold and carried off my finest treasures to your temples.
You sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, so that you could send them far from their own land.
"But I will stir them up to leave the places where you sold them, and I will turn back on your own heads what you have done.
I will sell your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the people of Sheba, a nation far away. The LORD has spoken."
Announce this among the nations: "Prepare for war! Stir up your soldiers! Let all the fighting men come forward and attack.
Hammer your plows into swords and your pruning hooks into spears. Let even the weak say, 'I am strong!'
Hurry and come, all you nations from every side, and gather there." LORD, bring down your warriors!
"Let the nations be stirred up. Let them come to the Valley of Jehoshaphat, because there I will sit to judge all the nations on every side.
Swing the sickle, because the harvest is ripe. Come, trample the grapes, because the winepress is full. The vats overflow, because their wickedness is so great!"
Crowds and more crowds are in the Valley of Decision! The day of the LORD is near in the Valley of Decision.
The sun and the moon will grow dark, and the stars will stop shining.
The LORD will roar from Zion and thunder from Jerusalem. The earth and the sky will shake. But the LORD will be a safe place for his people, a strong fortress for the people of Israel.
"Then you will know that I, the LORD your God, live in Zion, my holy mountain. Jerusalem will be holy, and foreigners will never again invade her.

"On that day the mountains will drip with new wine, and the hills will flow with milk. All the streams of Judah will flow with water. A spring will flow out of the LORD's house and water the Valley of Acacias.
But Egypt will be ruined, and Edom will become an empty wilderness, because of the violence they did to the people of Judah. They shed innocent blood in their land.
But Judah will be lived in forever, and Jerusalem through all generations.
I will forgive their guilt for bloodshed, which I have not yet forgiven. The LORD lives in Zion!"
